examinerReasoningText: Registration is refused under Trademark Act Section 2(d), 15 U.S.C. Section 1052(d), because the applicant's mark FORGE, when used on or in connection with the identified goods/services, so resembles the registered mark FORGE TECH as to be likely to cause confusion, to cause mistake, or to deceive. Specifically, the marks are visually and phonetically similar, and the goods in Class 9 overlap directly.

This Office Action is in response to applicant's communication filed on April 10, 2026. The requirement for a definitive identification of goods in Class 42 is made FINAL. The proposed wording remains overly broad under TMEP Section 1402.01.
